rationale: The stock is trading at 99.3% of its intraday range, essentially at the session high after a massive intraday reversal from $19.07 to $23.87 — a ~25% move already captured. Entering long here means chasing exhaustion at the top with minimal upside to the high ($0.03) and significant mean-reversion risk; entering short against a strong momentum move with 138 minutes remaining and elevated relative volume (7x) carries equal risk of continuation squeeze. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable given the extreme range position and tight spread offering no structural edge.
